# .NET MAUI {{ControlName}} Methods

The Telerik UI for .NET MAUI {{ControlName}} exposes methods that let you {{purpose}} from code. The control exposes the following methods:

* `MethodName(parameters)`&mdash;{{Description of what the method does.}} The method accepts the following parameters:
  * `paramName (type)`&mdash;{{Parameter description.}}
  * `paramName (type)`&mdash;{{Parameter description.}} The default value is `{{default-value}}`.

## Call the {{MethodName}} Method

The following example demonstrates how to call the `{{MethodName}}` method.

1. Define the {{ControlName}} in XAML:

    <snippet id='{{control-slug}}-{{method-slug}}-xaml' />

1. Add the `telerik` namespace:

    ```XAML
    xmlns:telerik="http://schemas.telerik.com/2022/xaml/maui"
    ```

1. Call the method in your code-behind:

    <snippet id='{{control-slug}}-{{method-slug}}' />
